key.text: Home is the workspace's current view (#208): one big panel the model keeps from the workspace's data, the last question above it and next steps under it. Switch chips change the view. First two views: the picture with parts pinned (bikes) and the wanted list (garage). Floor plans, renders and pinned answers (#450) come later in the same panel. Pills: + New · History · Things · Docs; the photo top right; Rename, icon and Archive in the ⋯.

likes.text: Owner liked: one big view the conversation drives (photo with parts pinned, plans, renders), the question above and next steps under it, a light header with the photo, picks with one shop button, Ideas ranked by value. Didn't like: a dashboard of small fixed blocks (the first mock), background like brands and sizes on screen, summary chips.

buyingkey.text: Picks: up to 3 per item, labelled ★ Best value, Cheapest that does the job, Worth stretching for, each with one line of why and one shop button. Prices say how fresh they are; a sale shows only inside the line. Ideas: improvements ranked by value (what you get, rough cost, effort); Want it moves one to Wanted, where it gets picks. Ideas come when asked, never pushed. Products, prices and shops here are made-up examples, not real picks.
